records.title: Tickets team To Do queue identity, authorized scope and count

sources.locator: UserInfo.isLeader selects TeamTasks exclusively, otherwise personal TicketsTable
buildRequestParams: IsEnquiryComplete=false for todo; response data.items and data.total
Second turn: real sidebar switch, authorized TeamTask/List complete two-pass id projection and actual todo view

bindings.meaning: Ticket entities in the authorized TeamTask/List result, without any subtype restriction.
One ticket per id; public enquiryNumber is a display label, not the entity key.
The authenticated server-scoped TeamTasks workspace; it is not the personal Management/List endpoint and does not by itself prove a requested managed-member subset.

The complete actual To Do queue returned by this operation with IsEnquiryComplete=false and no other population-changing request parameters. Queue membership is server-defined for the current principal, not an invented universal status filter.
Count ticket ids across the complete same-context collection, or the total only when proved to describe exactly that same population before paging.

fields.enquiryStatusId: Current ticket status; its membership meaning depends on the actual principal and view, not a universal pending value.

pagination.total: Count after current server authorization and actual filters, before paging.

relationships: The frontend uses the actual UserInfo.isLeader result to select TeamTasks. Do not choose this scope merely from a display name or role string; verify the observed operation under the current session.

Happiness Center membership and business-department membership use different pending buckets. Happiness Center team todo is below Resolved; business-department team todo is DepartmentProcessing and restricted by the actual leader-department or own-handler predicate. This is a server-enforced distinction, not permission granted by this knowledge.

For business departments, the server includes own assigned tickets and tickets assigned to departments the current user actually leads. Non-leaders remain limited to their own assigned tickets. The personal Management/List operation has separate documented membership and cannot replace this queue.

The nine status counters may span the union of todo and completed buckets; their total is not the selected todo count. Never use status-card total or another department/person queue to fill a missing current-list count.
GET IsEnquiryComplete=false is observed as the wire string false; PageIndex/PageSize/SortBy/SortDirection change presentation, not the proved complete population.
constraints: These are exact-context bindings. Extra date, status, subtype, search, priority or IsReopened parameters require their own verified requested meaning. Do not silently discard a requested filter or apply this unfiltered definition to a reopened query.
Completed is a separate view and population. No counts or live record values are supplied by this knowledge. Use a fresh authorized observation after each workspace/view switch.
Page, action, row and field permissions remain current-session checks. No export, reassignment, change-status or other write is authorized.
